items.difficulty_reason: Base change of the relative Cech complex along a 2-cartesian square: fixes y over T with x = e(y), computes Gamma(y, e^{-1}K^bullet(f, F)) as the Cech complex of the pulled-back covering over (Sch/T)_fppf, and identifies the two Cech complexes because 2-cartesianness makes the induced 1-morphism of slice 2-fibre products an equivalence, closing with lemma-generalities. Retained author proof at lines 3484-3514.
